question: Cross-room squad steering now consults the planned route every step: does it cost CPU?
method: docs/qa/counterflow-stress-20261115/steering-cpu-bench.mjs: 32 squad actors ordered two rooms away, 600 moveSquadActor steps at 1/60 s, median of 5 runs, ms of CPU per step for all 32. Node 22, same container, run twice alternately before/after.
reading: No added cost. Before the fix, actors oscillating against room walls recomputed local paths; after, they follow the planned route. Steering CPU only, outside the browser: not a frame time, GPU time or hardware capacity measurement.
limits: Two levels; no rendering, combat or simulation load; one container.
